verdict.rationale: Rainforest's marketing says it offers pre-built embeddable components for reporting [rainforest-docs-15]. Its docs cover merchant deposits [rainforest-docs-7] and say platforms can export payment and merchant data at any time [rainforest-docs-34]. That suggests an embeddable seller-facing reporting surface, but nothing shows what sellers can actually see or download themselves; the export right belongs to the platform, not the seller. Missing for 10: documented per-seller statements, a payout/deposit reconciliation report for sellers, seller-downloadable exports for bookkeepers, and detailed docs or hands-on evidence for the reporting component.
